segments.text: Is Christ your High-Priest, and is his Priestood so indispensably necessary to your salvation; then freely acknowledge your utter impotency to reconcile your selves to God, by any thing you can do, or suffer. And let Christ have the whole glory of your recovery ascribed to him. It's highly reasonable, that he that laid down the whole price, should have the whole praise. If any man think, or say, he could have made an attonement for himself; he doth therein cast no light reproach upon that profound wisdom, which laid the design of our redemption in the death of Christ. But of this I have spoken elsewhere. And therefore;
